title: Potato Talisman
wikitext:
{{Exclusive|Year/Pig}} {{Infobox/Accessory |rarity = Common |source = [[Shiny Pig]]s
[[Potato King]] (unavailable) |speed = 1 |salable = 1 |sell = 1,000,000 |upgrades_to = Potato Ring |museum = yes |museum_xp = 0 |museum_category = special |id = POTATO_TALISMAN }} The '''Potato Talisman''' is a {{Common}} [[Accessory]] made to commemorate the Great Potato War. == Obtaining == The '''Potato Talisman''' has a {{Chance|0.05%|1|2071|pigs}} to drop from {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}}s during the [[Year of the Pig]]. The chance is increased to {{Chance|0.07%|1|1381.66|pigs}} with {{Item|Pig Brain Mixin}} active. In addition, after completing {{Green|2,000}} {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}}s, next drop is guaranteed to be the '''Potato Talisman'''. Dropping {{Green|2}} items from a {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}} will count double towards pity. The player's progress towards this can be viewed using the [[Pity|{{code|/pity}}]] command. Every player was able to claim a '''Potato Talisman''' from the {{NPCSprite|Potato King}} near the [[Map (Hub)|Map]] from June 21, 2020 - June 26, 2020. It could also be a rare drop from [[Shiny Pig]]s during [[SkyBlock Anniversary]] events, with a drop chance of {{Green|0.02%}}. == Usage == The '''Potato Talisman''' grants {{Green|+1}} {{Stat|Speed}}. If the player has it in their inventory or [[Accessory Bag]], and is on their private island, it increases the speed of all {{Item|Potato Minion}}s on the island, by {{Green|5%}}.{{Affected Minions List|misc|potato|table_list=n|preamble_text=n}} === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == Trivia == *This item heavily references "Technoblade", a Minecraft YouTuber who was the first player to reach 500 million Potatoes in their collection. **Technoblade's journey to 500 million was a hard-won fight against player-turned-YouTuber "im_a_squid_kid". This became an event in the SkyBlock YouTube community, known as the "Great Potato War," which lasted over nine months. im_a_squid_kid's count at the time of Technoblade's surpassing him was around 412 million. ***Simon (Hypixel's founder) himself even chimed in on Twitterhttps://twitter.com/Simon_Hypixel/status/1237262450040475649, originally suggesting the war end at one billion (1,000,000,000) potatoes farmed. This was used as a catalyst for Technoblade and im_a_squid_kid to agree on a final count, settling at the 500 million mark. **The [[Potato King]], who granted this talisman its skin, was Technoblade. It is his skin, with a [[Potato]] on his head. **The {{Green|+1}} {{Stat|Speed}} may be in reference to the [[Pig's Foot]], which was added before the Great Potato War when Technoblade won a tournament called "Minecraft Monday," which was given its stats thanks to Technoblade's focus on {{Stat|Speed}} in his early SkyBlock videos. *Like the [[Crab Hat of Celebration]], [[Sloth Hat of Celebration]], and every '''unique''' [[New Year Cake]], the Potato Talisman could only be claimed once per profile. *Immediately after this update, the Potato Talisman could be placed on Private Islands. This was swiftly patched, although some players who had already placed the talisman did not have the blocks removed, so some instances may still remain. == History == {{History table |ahn = {{History|2026/Sep 30|({{gray|Experimental}}) Added [[Pities]] to the {{item|Potato Talisman}} ({{green|2,000}} {{Mob|Shiny Pig}}s), affected by the effect of the {{item|Pig Brain Mixin}}.}} |beta= {{History|2020/Jun 21|link=none|[[File:Potato Talisman.png|26px]] Added '''Potato Talisman'''.}} {{History|2026/Feb 24|Revamped the {{MobSprite|Shiny Pig}} loot table.}} {{History|0.27.2|Added [[Pities]] to the {{item|Potato Talisman}} ({{green|2,000}} {{Mob|Shiny Pig}}s), affected by the effect of the {{item|Pig Brain Mixin}}.|Added NPC sell price of {{Coins|1,000,000}}.}} }} == References == {{Reflist}} == Navigation == {{Nav/Accessories}} {{Nav/Yearly Events System}} [[Category:Talisman]] [[Category:Great Potato War]] [[Category:Special items]]
